title: Rig Relay Telemetry Consent v1
description: Content-light consent record for telemetry data sharing. No raw email, raw tokens, raw prompts, raw code, or raw output.

subject_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the subject identifier (account_id or participant_id). Not a raw email or account ID.

provider.description: Identity provider name (e.g. github, google) or 'local' for no-identity consent

granted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when consent was granted

revoked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when consent was revoked

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp when consent expires

policy_version.description: Version of the consent policy at time of recording

local_only.description: If true, consent is stored only locally and not synced to remote

warnings.description: Human-readable warnings about this consent record
